renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-reversible-step constellation-afterglow guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. These generation rules apply to the eleven new images; reuse the approved Sagittarius pilot byte-for-byte and never regenerate it. For each new image use the same-sign human-approved B085 close-emotion artwork as the primary identity and white-sclera purple-eye anchor, B086 only as the reversible-device continuity reference, and B084 only as the disconnected-afterglow spacing reference; never copy their composition. Preserve canonical body, relative scale, colors, signature features, coherent pupil direction, dark-purple outlines and visible chest Stella stars. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair and no extra adviser, partner, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or implied person. Guardian or pair plus one returned or removable trial remnant, one visibly separate rollback control and one blank revisit marker covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Show only two or three isolated afterglow patches separated by broad empty gaps; they may echo the chest star, trial remnant and revisit marker but must never connect into a constellation, route, promise, verdict, destiny or guaranteed return. Keep every socket, support, fork, shelf, tray, recess and marker broken, open-sided, notched, loose, removable or unlatched. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, hourglass, calendar grid, map, coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. No literal key, connected path, closed circle, ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, cage, locked box or deterministic direction. Do not add a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. Keep every composition distinct from B001–87 and from the other eleven cards. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor with visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and dreamy violet-peach-gold lighting; no naturalistic-animal drift, rough crayon, flat vector, readable text, logo or watermark.
